$comment: The KernelSU late-load build this target would pair with. CI rebuilds it
from the src/kernelsu submodule; nothing is committed as a binary.
'id' names the published assets (ksud-<id>, kernelsu-<id>.ko). Targets that
load the same module share one id and are built once.
'kernelRelease' is the exact UTS release the module must report in its
vermagic. The DDK image ships its own release string, so the build
overwrites the generated utsrelease.h and kernel.release with this value
before compiling.
This is the first android14-6.1 build in the repository -- the others are
android15-6.6 and android16-6.12 -- so it is the first to use that DDK
image. It has been built and loaded on the device: ksud staged by the
bootstrap helper, `late-load: KernelSU loaded and answering (0)`, and the
manager showing `動作中 <LKM> [Jailbreak mode]` with version
32525-2, the kernel release below, and SELinux back to Enforcing --
including from the application's own route. Every one of those loads was of
a module built locally in the DDK image the way the action does it; CI has
never produced this pair, and now that the target's kernelVersion is set it
is in the job a release waits on, so the first CI build of it is the thing
to watch.
'patchSets' names the patch sets this build takes on top of common, as
directories under the patch submodule's patches/<version>/. XIG07 takes
none: HyperOS on this device has no KDP/RKP/DEFEX, so it builds against a
tree carrying only common, whose staged late-load the bootstrap helper
drives.
